about: Re-reads of the Storm Charles map: what changed since the first read (10 November, 23:38 to 23:48 UTC). Press headlines are evidence, quoted briefly with their source; IPMA's lines are facts read from IPMA. Not a forecast of ours.

changed_in_the_coverage.label: evidence
changed_in_the_coverage.who: The Weather Channel (weather.com), Lisbon's page, rendered 13:38Z
changed_in_the_coverage.what: incident.shadow@'s lead was that weather.com showed no alerts for Lisbon during the red rain. That did not hold at this read. The page leads with "Extreme wind warning, From Tue 07:18 until Wed 21:00 WET" ("+5 More"); its alerts page credits IPMA through EUMETNET-MeteoAlarm and lists six warnings, the first "Extreme wind warning ... Wind gusts up to 140 km/h". IPMA lowered Lisbon's wind from red to orange by CAP at 07:16:30Z, and since 12:33 it runs only to 18:00. MeteoAlarm's feed at 13:37 carries no red wind message for Lisbon. The other five match IPMA's messages (red rain to 15:00, orange wind to 18:00, yellow rain 15:00 to 18:00, the two sea warnings), except that the yellow sea warning shows a start of "Tue 07:18" instead of Wednesday 21:00. A reader of weather.com sees a red wind warning as the headline, about six hours after IPMA withdrew it. The page carries MeteoAlarm's disclaimer about delays
